title: Count Paths With the Given XOR Value
summary: Given a grid of size m x n and an integer k, calculate the number of paths from the top-left to the bottom-right cell where the XOR of all numbers on the path equals k.
statement: Given a grid of size m x n and an integer k, calculate the number of paths from the top-left to the bottom-right cell where the XOR of all numbers on the path equals k. You can only move right or down, and the result should be modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: grid has at most 300 rows and columns; every value and k is in 0..15.
Move only right or down from the top-left to bottom-right cell.
Count paths whose inclusive cell XOR equals k, modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Only sixteen XOR states can reach each cell.
Accumulate path counts by ending cell and current XOR, reusing the previous row.
For each cell, XOR its value into every state arriving from above and left.
Every valid path has one unique final move, so the two predecessor distributions partition all paths.
editorial: Every valid path has one unique final move, so the two predecessor distributions partition all paths.

tests.explanation: Exactly three right/down paths produce XOR eleven.
The single-cell path has XOR zero, so it contributes one.
